Summarize a multi-chain multiggm fit

Source: R/methods.R
summary.multiggm_fit_list.Rd

Summarizes each chain and the pooled posterior. The pooled edge counts use posterior inclusion probabilities averaged over all chains. The largest difference between two chains' PIPs (or, for mGHS, posterior mean partial correlations) is a quick convergence check: chains that agree give small values.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'multiggm_fit_list'
summary(object, pip_threshold = 0.5, ...)

Arguments

object

A multiggm_fit_list returned by multiggm_mcmc with nchains > 1.

pip_threshold

Numeric; PIP threshold for the edge counts. Default 0.5.

...

Ignored.

Value

An object of class "summary.multiggm_fit_list": a list with chains (the per-chain summaries), edge_counts (pooled, per group, or NULL for mGHS), max_chain_diff (largest absolute between-chain difference, per group), nchains, K and pip_threshold.

See also

summary.multiggm_fit(), plot.multiggm_fit_list()

Examples

sim <- simulate_multiggm(K = 2, p = 6, n = 60, seed = 1)
fit <- multiggm_mcmc(data_list = sim$data_list, burnin = 100, nsave = 50,
                     nchains = 2, seed = 1)
summary(fit)
